legacySurveyTakeaway.text: Separates planning from grounding and shows the gap between them is where web agents fail: GPT-4V completed 51.1 percent of live tasks when its textual plans were manually grounded. For this project the relevant consequence is that the grounding stage is what emits the actual click and type events, so an agent's trace signature is shaped by its grounding strategy rather than by its reasoning.
